facts.fact: Hespress reports that Law No. 09.08 on the processing of personal data, adopted in 2009, has remained largely unchanged, and that a draft bill amending it (prepared by the CNDP with the Ministry of Justice, covering AI, blockchain and precision medicine) has reached the General Secretariat of the Government.
